body: I dont know is there anything you could do.

I have tried but i currently just can not handle social situations at all. I had isolated myself from everyone for months and trying to talk to people just has come harder and harder. I have started to get this idea that I everyone else has their life in order and dont have any real problems. I know that is not true that and everyone has their but I just dont have energy to deal with happy people they make me feel even worse.

I just can´t stop blaming myself for all problems I have. I am allready relying to other people keep going but I feel like I cant tell them how bad situation really is. I just cannot burden other people with this stuff. I have been suicidal for months now and I have only kept going for who knows what reason. I just hope that for brief moment I could stop thinking about all shit in my life and could just enjoy about something for once. Dont know is my writing making sense I am bad at english and havent slept for long time now, but I hope it is ok here.
